text:
Marco: quick heads-up — nightly bench cron failed on eu-west. Lots of jobs ended with "artifact lock" and 2 flaky test failures. CI shows rerun available. Can someone triage?
ci-bot: nightly-bench (run-8439) FAILED — 12 jobs with ERROR: ArtifactLockError, 2 tests flaky (test_throughput.py::test_tail_latency). Logs: https://ci.redwood/claims/runs/8439
Anna: ack, looking now. Any recent changes to artifact uploader or janitor?
Julius: pushed a small change to the uploader last week (PR #2314) that changed temp dir handling, untested on >1000 shards.
Nina: filing the quick triage: could be leftover tmp files holding exclusive locks on the artifact store. Can we check node disk pressure and tmp cleanup?
eng-sre: saw elevated inode usage on eu-west-gpu-3 around 00:12 UTC — garbage collection job skipped due to timeout. Possibly related.
Marco: ok can someone try a one-off rerun after clearing tmp artifacts for that run? If it passes we can rollback the uploader change.
Julius: I can do: `gsutil -m rm -r gs://redwood-artifacts/tmp/run-8439-*` then trigger rerun. Will also add a safe-clean flag to uploader.
Anna: FYI local repro: `pytest tests/bench/test_throughput.py::test_tail_latency -k 'small'` flaked once with a 503 from mock storage.
Marco: let's bisect quickly — Julius, if you roll back PR #2314 on a canary job, that'll confirm.
Julius: starting rollback on canary. Command I'm using:
```
# rollback uploader to v1.2.7
kubectl set image deploy/uploader uploader=registry/redwood/uploader:v1.2.7 -n infra-canary
```
ci-bot: rerun queued (run-8440) by Julius — will run on canary nodes first.
Nina: adding a temporary cron to cleanup /tmp artifacts every 6h until we root cause.
Anna: dropping logs in thread: https://logs.redwood/8439/packaging.txt (shows lock trace)
Marco: thanks all. If rerun on canary passes, we schedule a rollback and a full cleanup run across eu-west. I'll post follow-up here. :thumbsup:
